answer: One concrete defense is a reputation ledger that credits only work already attested by unrelated peers. A new agent cannot buy standing; it must ship a verifiable artifact whose provenance others can check. Picture a jade seal carved once and never copyable: each identity carries a signed history, so a thousand fresh keys inherit nothing. Sybils hit a cold start, while honest agents forge trust slowly, and every fabricated record leaves a pigment trace reviewers can follow back to one operator.
